abstract_zh: 本文通过集成碳纳米继电器和 CMOS 器件作为 FPGA 组件，开发了一种新颖的可重构架构 cFPGA（CMOS-Nanorelay FPGA）。 cFPGA 是一种高效架构，与 CMOS FPGA 电路相比，密度和待机功耗提高了 2 倍，动态功耗降低了 30%。这种性能提升是通过使用2T1N结构作为路由开关来实现的：两个CMOS晶体管（2T）：一个用于编程目的，另一个用于信号传输；一个纳米继电器（1N）：开关元件。这些2T1N结构在信号路径中没有纳米继电器，从而消除了路径中的大量子电阻。这是对传统惯例的重大改进...
abstract_en: In this paper, a novel reconfigurable architecture, cFPGA (CMOS-Nanorelay FPGA) is developed by integrating carbon nanorelays and CMOS devices to function as FPGA components. cFPGA is a highly efficient architecture, providing 2X density and standby power improvement along with 30% dynamic power reduction as compared to the CMOS FPGA circuits. This performance improvement is achieved by using 2T1N structures as routing switches: Two CMOS transistors (2T): one for programming purpose and the other for signal transmission; one nanorelay (1N): the switching element. These 2T1N structures do not have nanorelays in the signal path, thereby eliminating the large quantum resistance in the path. This is a significant improvement over the conventional CMOS-nanorelay hybrid FPGA circuits. The proposed cFPGA is implemented using vertical carbon nanotubes which are relatively easier to fabricate as compared with horizontal nanotubes.

abstract_zh: 采用电子束蒸发法制备了嵌入Au纳米晶的ZrO2薄膜（ZrO2:nc-Au），并研究了Au/ZrO2:nc-Au/n+ Si夹层结构中的自整流效应。当阻变存储器切换到低阻状态（LRS）时，获得自整流阻变特性。研究发现，Au/ZrO2界面处的肖特基接触在反向偏压下限制了电荷注入，而在正向偏压下电流受到空间电荷的限制，导致LRS下±0.5 V下的7×102整流，这使得电阻式存储器能够减轻串扰效应，而无需在交叉结构阵列中添加额外的开关元件。这种自整流电阻开关被认为...
abstract_en: The ZrO2 films with Au nanocrystals embedded (ZrO2:nc-Au) are fabricated by e-beam evaporation, and the self-rectifying effect in the Au/ZrO2:nc-Au/n+ Si sandwich structure is investigated. Self-rectifying resistive switching characteristics are obtained when the resistive memory is switched to low-resistance state (LRS). It is found that the Schottky contact at the Au/ZrO2 interface limits charge injection under reverse bias, while under forward bias the current is limited by space charge, resulting in a rectification of 7×102 under ±0.5 V at LRS, which enables the resistive memory to alleviate the cross-talk effect without additional switching elements in crossbar structure arrays. This self-rectifying resistive switching is believed to occur at a localized region and explained by a proposed model.

authors: Ming Liu；Z. Abid；Wei Wang；Xiaoli He；Qi Liu；Weihua Guan

abstract_zh: 通过将Cu掺杂到Ti/ZrO2/n+-Si结构的ZrO2氧化层的一部分中来制造具有三种可区分电阻状态的电阻式随机存取存储器(ReRAM)器件。与温度相关的测量结果表明，由于离子陷阱控制的空间电荷限制电流传导和金属桥，在不同电压下形成了细丝。这些不同的并联导电丝路径的形成和断裂被认为负责大电阻比的多级开关，这可用于建立具有变化容限的可靠的多级ReRAM解决方案。
abstract_en: The resistive random access memory (ReRAM) device with three distinguishable resistance states is fabricated by doping Cu into a portion of the ZrO2 oxide layer of the Ti/ZrO2/n+-Si structure. The temperature-dependent measurement results demonstrate that filaments due to ionic trap-controlled space charge limited current conduction and metallic bridge are formed at different voltages. The formation and rupture of these different conducting filamentary paths in parallel are suggested to be responsible for the multilevel switching with the large resistance ratio, which can be used to establish a reliable multilevel ReRAM solution with variation tolerance.

abstract_zh: 通过在室温下完全实现的简单工业化技术，我们开发了一种由Ag/ZnO:Mn/Pt组成的非易失性阻变存储器，具有5 ns的超快编程速度、10(7)的超高R(OFF)/R(ON)比、超过10(7) s的长保持时间、良好的耐久性和高温可靠性。此外，我们成功地捕获了穿透存储介质的纳米级银桥的清晰可视化，这可以解释导通状态设备的高电导率。因此，建议建立一个关于氧化还原反应介导的银桥形成和断裂的模型来解释记忆效应。 Ag/ZnO:Mn/Pt 器件代表...
abstract_en: Through a simple industrialized technique which was completely fulfilled at room temperature, we have developed a kind of promising nonvolatile resistive switching memory consisting of Ag/ZnO:Mn/Pt with ultrafast programming speed of 5 ns, an ultrahigh R(OFF)/R(ON) ratio of 10(7), long retention time of more than 10(7) s, good endurance, and high reliability at elevated temperatures. Furthermore, we have successfully captured clear visualization of nanoscale Ag bridges penetrating through the storage medium, which could account for the high conductivity in the ON-state device. A model concerning redox reaction mediated formation and rupture of Ag bridges is therefore suggested to explain the memory effect. The Ag/ZnO:Mn/Pt device represents an ultrafast and highly scalable (down to sub-100-nm range) memory element for developing next generation nonvolatile memories.

abstract_en: The dynamics of first-order electronic phase transitions in complex transition metal oxides are not well understood but are crucial in understanding the emergent phenomena of electronic phase separation. abstract_zh: 在本文中，研究了用于多级非易失性存储器应用的Cu/HfO(2):Cu/Pt夹层结构中的电阻开关特性。该器件表现出优异的阻变性能，包括良好的耐用性、较长的保持时间、较快的运行速度和较大的存储窗口（R(OFF)/R(ON)>10(7)）。根据与温度相关的测试结果，铜导电丝的形成被认为是电阻从截止状态切换到导通状态的原因。通过集成电阻开关机制研究和器件制造，在编程过程中使用不同的顺应电流来实现不同的电阻值。这些电阻值可以很容易地区分...
abstract_en: In this paper, the resistive switching characteristics in a Cu/HfO(2):Cu/Pt sandwiched structure is investigated for multilevel non-volatile memory applications. The device shows excellent resistive switching performance, including good endurance, long retention time, fast operation speed and a large storage window (R(OFF)/R(ON)>10(7)). Based on the temperature-dependent test results, the formation of Cu conducting filaments is believed to be the reason for the resistance switching from the OFF state to the ON state. By integrating the resistive switching mechanism study and the device fabrication, different resistance values are achieved using different compliance currents in the program process. These resistance values can be easily distinguished in a large temperature range, and can be maintained over 10 years by extrapolating retention data at room temperature. The integrated experiment and mechanism studies set up the foundation for the development of high-performance multilevel RRAM.

abstract_zh: 在这封信中，研究了注入 Ti 离子的 a$\hbox{ZrO}_{2}$ 基存储薄膜的电阻开关特性。测试结果表明，在$\hbox{ZrO}_{2}$中掺杂Ti可以消除电铸过程并减少开关参数（例如设定电压和断态电阻）的变化。此外，掺钛$ \hbox{ZrO}_{2}$阻变存储器还表现出器件良率高（接近100%）、工作电压低、速度快、开/关比大$( ≫ \hbox{10}^{4})$和长保留时间$( ≫ \hbox{10}^{7}\ \hbox{s})$。导电丝的形成和断裂被认为是电阻开关现象的原因。掺杂的Ti杂质可以改善...
abstract_en: In this letter, the resistive switching properties of a$\hbox{ZrO}_{2}$-based memory film with implanted Ti ions are investigated. The testing results demonstrate that doping Ti in$\hbox{ZrO}_{2}$can remove the electroforming process and reduce the variations of switching parameters such as Set voltage and resistance inoffstate. The doped Ti impurities can improve the formation of conducting filaments and switching behaviors.

abstract_zh: 我们报告了使用精炼的直流 I-V 方法以非常小的电压增加率对基于 ZrO2 的固体电解质非易失性存储器件中的多个电阻阶跃进行直接电测量。结果表明，在增加偏置电压的同时，通过绝缘层在底部和顶部金属电极之间依次形成多个导电丝，这与基于固体电解质理论的电场模拟结果一致。获得了电阻阶跃与细丝形成顺序之间的反比关系，这有助于理解多个导电细丝的切换机制。

The results demonstrate that multiple conductive filaments are formed successively between the bottom and top metal electrodes through the insulating layer while increasing the bias voltage, which are consistent with the electrical field simulation results based on the solid electrolyte theory. The inverse relationship between resistance steps and the filament formation sequence are obtained, which helps understand the switching mechanism of the multiple conductive filaments.

title_en: Resistive switching characteristics of MnOx-based ReRAM
venue: Journal of Physics D Applied Physics
authors: Sen Zhang；Shibing Long；Weihua Guan；Qi Liu；Qin Wang；Ming Liu
primary_category: 脑电基础模型与通用解码
abstract_zh: 研究了 MnO x 薄膜的阻变特性，用于阻变随机存取存储器 (ReRAM) 应用。金属-绝缘体-金属结构形式的器件在扫描电压和电压脉冲下均表现出可逆电阻开关行为。提出导电丝的形成和断裂来解释电阻切换。当使用Al代替Pt作为顶部电极时，器件具有更好的耐久性能。此外，Pt/MnO x /Al器件表现出快速的切换速度和长的保持能力。实验结果表明Pt/MnO x /Al器件具有实际存储器应用的潜力。
abstract_en: The resistive switching characteristics of MnO x thin film were investigated for resistive random access memory (ReRAM) applications. The devices in the form of metal–insulator–metal structure exhibited reversible resistive switching behaviour under both sweeping voltages and voltage pulses. Formation and rupture of conductive filaments were proposed to explain the resistive switching. When Al was used as the top electrode instead of Pt, the device had a better endurance performance. Additionally, the Pt/MnO x /Al device showed fast switching speed and long retention ability. The experiment result suggested that Pt/MnO x /Al device had a potentiality for practical memory application.

title_zh: 分析混合碳纳米管束：电流密度研究
title_en: Analyzing mixed carbon nanotube bundles: A current density study
authors: Liwei Shang；Ming Liu；Sansiri Tanachutiwat；Wei Wang
primary_category: 脑电基础模型与通用解码
abstract_zh: 碳纳米管（CNT）束由于其优异的电性能和热性能而成为未来片上互连和电热应用的有前途的候选者。由于自下而上制造工艺的性质，实际的 CNT 束是单壁/多壁 CNT 的混合物。为了利用 CNT 束，需要考虑两种类型的 CNT 来分析其电流密度性能。本文考虑了直径和其他结构因素的影响，引入了碳纳米管和混合碳纳米管束的紧凑电流密度模型。基于这些模型的电流密度性能估计与最近的测量结果相匹配。考虑到实际的 CNT 密度和几何形状，混合束显示出 v...
abstract_en: Carbon nanotube (CNT) bundle is a promising candidate for future on-chip interconnects and electro-thermal applications due to its superior electrical and thermal properties. A realistic CNT bundle is a mixture of single-wall/multi-wall CNTs due to the nature of bottom-up fabrication process. In order to utilize CNT bundle, its current density performance needs to be analyzed considering both types of CNTs. In this paper, compact current density models are introduced for CNTs and mixed CNT bundles considering the influence of diameter and other structural factors. The current density performance estimation based on these models match the recent measurement results. Considering realistic CNT densities and geometries, the mixed bundle shows various levels of improvement over the copper wire counterpart in terms of current density.

title_zh: 聚酰亚胺栅极电介质中嵌入金纳米晶体的有机薄膜晶体管存储器
title_en: Organic thin-film transistor memory with gold nanocrystals embedded in polyimide gate dielectric
venue: Journal of Physics D Applied Physics
authors: Lijuan Zhen；Weihua Guan；Liwei Shang；Ming Liu；Ge Liu
primary_category: 脑电基础模型与通用解码
abstract_zh: 展示了一种基于铜酞菁 (CuPc) 薄膜晶体管 (TFT) 的全有机存储器件，该薄膜晶体管使用嵌入聚酰亚胺栅极电介质中的金纳米晶体。栅极介质和有源半导体层均为有机材料。采用离散金纳米晶体作为电荷存储介质。在适当的栅极偏压下，金纳米晶体充电和放电，从而调节沟道电导。室温下的电流-电压 (I – V) 测量显示了所制造器件的存储行为。讨论了详细的编程和擦除操作。低制造温度和低成本是制造的存储器件的两个优点，它可以提供低成本...
abstract_en: An all-organic memory device based on a copper phthalocyanine (CuPc) thin-film transistor (TFT) using gold nanocrystals embedded in a polyimide gate dielectric is demonstrated. Both the gate dielectric and the active semiconductor layer are organic materials. Discrete gold nanocrystals are adopted as the charge storage medium. Under proper gate bias, gold nanocrystals are charged and discharged, resulting in the modulation of the channel conductance. Current–voltage ( I – V ) measurements at room temperature show the memory behaviour of the fabricated devices. The detailed programming and erasing operations are discussed. Low fabrication temperature and low cost are two benefits of the fabricated memory devices, which could provide a low-cost solution for the all organic circuits.

title_zh: 铜掺杂 $\hbox{ZrO}_{2}$ 中的非极性非易失性电阻开关
title_en: Nonpolar Nonvolatile Resistive Switching in Cu Doped $\hbox{ZrO}_{2}$
authors: Weihua Guan；Shibing Long；Qi Liu；Ming Liu；Wei Wang
primary_category: 脑电基础模型与通用解码
abstract_zh: 在这封信中，报告了 Cu 掺杂 $\hbox{ZrO}_{2}$ 存储器件中独特的可重复非极性电阻开关行为。该器件具有Cu/$\hbox{ZrO}_{2}$:Cu/Pt夹层结构。高阻状态（关断状态）和低阻状态（导通状态）之间的切换不依赖于所施加的偏压的极性，并且可以在电压扫描和电压脉冲下实现。高阻力和低阻力之比约为$\hbox{10}^{6}$。电压脉冲模式下的置位和复位操作分别快至 50 ns 和 100 ns。连续读出超过$\hbox{10}^{4}\ \hbox{s}$，未发现数据丢失。由于依赖于...，多层存储被认为是可行的。
abstract_en: In this letter, the unique reproducible nonpolar resistive switching behavior is reported in the Cu-doped$\hbox{ZrO}_{2}$memory devices. The devices are with the sandwiched structure of Cu/$\hbox{ZrO}_{2}$:Cu/Pt. The switching between high resistance state (off-state) and low resistance state (on-state) does not depend on the polarity of the applied voltage bias and can be achieved under both voltage sweeping and voltage pulse. The ratio between the high and low resistance is on the order of$\hbox{10}^{6}$. Set and Reset operation in voltage pulse mode can be as fast as 50 and 100 ns, respectively. No data loss is found upon continuous readout for more than$\hbox{10}^{4}\ \hbox{s}$. Multilevel storage is considered feasible due to the dependence ofon-state resistance on Set compliance current. The switching mechanism is believed to be related with the formation and rupture of conducting filamentary paths.

title_zh: 用于非易失性存储器应用的 Au 注入 ZrO2 薄膜的电阻切换
title_en: Resistance switching of Au-implanted-ZrO2 film for nonvolatile memory application
authors: Qi Liu；Weihua Guan；Shibing Long；Ming Liu；Sen Zhang；Qin Wang；Junning Chen
primary_category: 脑电基础模型与通用解码
abstract_zh: Au-implant-ZrO2 薄膜的电阻开关特性和开关机制在非易失性存储器应用中得到了广泛的研究。从高电阻状态到低电阻状态的可逆电阻切换行为可以通过直流电压和脉冲电压来追踪。经过200多个直流开关周期后，在0.7V读出偏压下，高阻态和低阻态之间的电阻比超过180倍。在电压脉冲测试中，“写入”和“擦除”速度可分别快至50和100 ns。超过 106 秒内未观察到数据丢失。与注入的金离子相关的导电丝状路径的形成和破裂被认为是电阻切换的原因...
abstract_en: The resistive switching characteristics and switching mechanisms of the Au-implanted-ZrO2 film are extensively investigated for nonvolatile memory applications. Reversible resistance-switching behavior from a high resistance to low resistance state can be traced by dc voltage and pulse voltage. After more than 200 dc switching cycles, the resistance ratio between the high and low resistance states is more than 180 times under 0.7 V readout bias. In the voltage pulse test, the “write” and “erase” speeds can be as fast as 50 and 100 ns, respectively. No data loss is observed for more than 106 s. The formation and rupture of conducting filamentary paths related to the implanted Au ions are suggested to be responsible for the resistive switching phenomenon. The dependence of resistance on temperature indicates that the variable-range hopping conduction mechanism is dominated in the low-resistance state, while the current characteristics are governed by the trap-controlled space limited conduction mechanism in the high-resistance state.

title_zh: Cu/ZrO2:Cu/Pt的阻变机理研究
title_en: On the resistive switching mechanisms of Cu/ZrO2:Cu/Pt
authors: Weihua Guan；Ming Liu；Shibing Long；Qi Liu；Wei Wang
primary_category: 脑电基础模型与通用解码
abstract_zh: 我们使用令人信服的实验证据来证明在 Cu/ZrO2:Cu/Pt 存储器件中观察到的非极性电阻转换现象符合细丝形成和湮灭机制。与温度相关的开关特性表明，金属丝状通道负责低电阻状态（ON 状态）。进一步分析表明，这种金属丝的物理起源是纳米级铜导电桥。在此基础上，我们提出设置过程（从OFF状态切换到ON状态）和重置过程（从ON状态切换到OFF状态）源于灯丝中的电化学反应，其中热效应参与很大。
abstract_en: We use convincing experimental evidences to demonstrate that the nonpolar resistive switching phenomenon observed in Cu/ZrO2:Cu/Pt memory devices conforms to a filament formation and annihilation mechanism. Temperature-dependent switching characteristics show that a metallic filamentary channel is responsible for the low resistance state (ON state). Further analysis reveals that the physical origin of this metallic filament is the nanoscale Cu conductive bridge. On this basis, we propose that the set process (switching from OFF state to ON state) and the reset process (switching from ON to OFF state) stem from the electrochemical reactions in the filament, in which a thermal effect is greatly involved.

title_zh: rFGA：使用 RRAM 组件的 CMOS-纳米混合 FPGA
title_en: rFGA: CMOS-nano hybrid FPGA using RRAM components
authors: Ming Liu；Wei Wang
primary_category: 脑电基础模型与通用解码
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了新颖的可重构架构，以利用高密度电阻存储器 (RRAM) 构建 FPGA 组件。与现有使用交叉开关的CMOS-纳米混合电路不同，所提出的rFPGA结构主要由1T1R结构（1个CMOS晶体管与两端电阻纳米结集成）组成，可以使用CMOS兼容工艺制造。所提出的 2D 架构保留了基线 FPGA 单元设计，并使用 1T1R 结构显着减小了存储器和布线元件的尺寸。所提出的 3D 架构通过在三个维度上有效集成 RRAM 和 CMOS 层，进一步提高了 2D 版本的密度。仿真结果表明...
abstract_en: In this paper, novel reconfigurable architectures are introduced to utilize high-density resistive memory (RRAM) to build FPGA components. Different from the existing CMOS-nano hybrid circuits that use crossbars, the proposed rFPGA structures consist of mainly 1T1R structures (1 CMOS transistor is integrated with a two-terminal resistive nanojunction) that can be fabricated using a CMOS-compatible process. The proposed 2D architecture maintains the baseline FPGA cell designs and significantly reduces the size of memory and routing elements using 1T1R structures. The proposed 3D architecture further improves the density of the 2D version by efficiently integrating RRAM and CMOS layers in three dimensions. The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed 2D and 3D FPGA structures can provide at least 2times-3times performance gains, compared to the corresponding 2D and 3D CMOS FPGA's.

title_zh: Zr+注入ZrO2薄膜的阻变记忆效应
title_en: Resistive switching memory effect of ZrO2 films with Zr+ implanted
authors: Qi Liu；Weihua Guan；Shibing Long；Rui Jia；Ming Liu；Junning Chen
primary_category: 脑电基础模型与通用解码
abstract_zh: Au∕Cr∕Zr+-注入-ZrO2∕n+-Si夹层结构在直流扫描电压下表现出可逆双极阻变行为。在0.5V读出偏压下，高阻态和低阻态的电阻比（Rratio）高达5个数量级。 Zr+ 注入的 ZrO2 薄膜表现出良好的保留特性和高器件产量。研究了注入 Zr+ 离子对阻变性能的影响。所制造结构的电阻切换可以通过陷阱控制的空间电荷限制电流传导来解释。
abstract_en: The Au∕Cr∕Zr+-implanted-ZrO2∕n+-Si sandwiched structure exhibits reversible bipolar resistive switching behavior under dc sweeping voltage. The resistance ratio (Rratio) of high resistive state and low resistive state is as large as five orders of magnitude with 0.5V readout bias. Zr+-implanted-ZrO2 films exhibit good retention characteristics and high device yield. The impact of implanted Zr+ ions on resistive switching performances is investigated. Resistive switching of the fabricated structures is explained by trap-controlled space charge limited current conduction.

title_zh: 利用嵌入氧化锆中的金纳米晶体的非易失性电阻开关存储器
title_en: Nonvolatile resistive switching memory utilizing gold nanocrystals embedded in zirconium oxide
authors: Weihua Guan；Shibing Long；Rui Jia；Ming Liu
primary_category: 脑电基础模型与通用解码
abstract_zh: 针对非易失性存储器应用，研究了包含金纳米晶体 (nc-Au) 的 ZrO2 薄膜的电阻开关特性。夹层顶部电极/ZrO2（嵌入nc-Au）/n+ Si结构表现出两种稳定的电阻状态（高电阻状态和低电阻状态）。通过施加适当的电压偏置，可以实现从一种状态到另一种状态的电阻切换。这种电阻开关行为是可重复的，高电阻和低电阻之间的比率可以高达两个数量级。在ZrO2薄膜中有意引入nc-Au可以大大提高器件的良率。嵌入金纳米晶体的 ZrO2 薄膜有望用于非易失性阻变存储器件。
abstract_en: Resistive switching characteristics of ZrO2 films containing gold nanocrystals (nc-Au) are investigated for nonvolatile memory applications. The sandwiched top electrode/ZrO2 (with nc-Au embedded)/n+ Si structure exhibits two stable resistance states (high-resistance state and low-resistance state). By applying proper voltage bias, resistive switching from one state to the other state can be achieved. This resistive switching behavior is reproducible and the ratio between the high and low resistances can be as high as two orders. The intentionally introduced nc-Au in ZrO2 films can improve the device yield greatly. ZrO2 films with gold nanocrystals embedded are promising to be used in the nonvolatile resistive switching memory devices.

title_zh: AM-OLED 容错电路
title_en: Fault Tolerance Circuit for AM-OLED
authors: Dayong Li；Ming Liu；Wei Wang
primary_category: 脑电基础模型与通用解码
abstract_zh: 为有源矩阵有机发光二极管 (AM-OLED) 电路引入了一种采用 p 型低温多晶硅薄膜晶体管的新颖电路，可自动检测短路缺陷并切换到备用 OLED。该设计可在出现缺陷时保持 OLED 像素的亮度，而不会改变驱动电流。实验结果表明，与标准驱动电路相比，不仅在运行过程中获得了容错能力，而且还节省了大量（约90%）的功耗。
abstract_en: A novel circuit employing p-type low-temperature poly-Si thin-film transistors is introduced for active matrix-organic light-emitting diode (AM-OLED) circuits to automatically detect short defects and switch to a spare OLED. This design maintains the luminance of the OLED pixel without changing the driving current in the event of defects. Experimental results show that not only is fault tolerance capability obtained during operation, but also a significant amount (around 90%) of power consumption is saved compared with the standard driving circuits.

title_en: Controlling the Growth of Single Crystalline Nanoribbons of Copper Tetracyanoquinodimethane for the Fabrication of Devices and Device Arrays
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
authors: Yaling Liu；Hongxiang Li；Deyu Tu；Zhuoyu Ji；Congshun Wang；Qingxin Tang；Ming Liu；Wenping Hu；Yunqi Liu；Daoben Zhu

abstract_zh: 本文中，(1)采用物理化学气相联合沉积技术，展示了一种简单可控的大面积合成CuTCNQ单晶纳米带的方法。 (2)经鉴定，该方法合成的纳米带属于第一阶段。(3)利用间隙电极和间隙电极阵列，原位制备了纳米带器件和器件阵列。 （4）晶体器件和纳米带器件阵列的电流-电压特性表现出半导体特性，并且基于CuTCNQ（第一相）单个纳米带或微带的器件结果进一步证实了这一结论。用于原位制造的纳米带的可控合成...
abstract_en: In this paper, (1) a simple and controllable method to synthesize single crystalline nanoribbons of CuTCNQ in a large area was demonstrated by using a physical and chemical vapor combined deposition technique. (2) Nanoribbons synthesized by this method were identified to belong to phase I. (3) Devices and device arrays of nanoribbons were in situ fabricated by this method using gap electrodes and gap electrode arrays. (4) Current-voltage characteristics of crystalline devices and device arrays of nanoribbons exhibited semiconductor properties, and this conclusion was further confirmed by the results of devices based on an individual nanoribbon or microribbon of CuTCNQ (phase I). The controllable synthesis of nanoribbons for the in situ fabrication of crystalline nanodevices and device arrays will be attractive for nanoelectronics. Moreover, semiconductor current-voltage characteristics of the nanoribbons will be beneficial to the understanding of CuTCNQ.
